question: The S-400 Triumf (Russian for Triumph) Missile System is _______ missile defense system designed in Russia.
solution:
The correct answer is **surface-to-air**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• S-400 is called Triumf(read Triumph).
 
• S-400 is a missile defense system.
 
• India signed a deal with Russia in October 2018 for the delivery of 5 missile defense systems.
 
• The deal was for US $5.43 billion.
 
• India faced the threat of sanctions at the time of signing of the deal by Countering America’s Adversaries Through Sanctions Act (CAATSA).
 
• The system can engage in all types of aerial targets:

 
• Aircraft
 
• Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
 
• Ballistic Missiles
 
• Cruise Missiles

 
• S-400 can track 100 airborne targets and engage 6 targets simultaneously.
 
• S-400 is developed by Almaz Central Design Bureau, Russia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The first successful test was carried out by Russia in 1999.
 
• S-400 was inducted by the Russian Army in 2001.
 
• Dr. Alexander Lemanskiy was the Chief Engineer for S-400.
 
• Terminal High Altitude Area Defence System(THAAD) is a US-developed missile defense system equivalent to S-400.
